scope: Managed storage admission for generated PDF patch triangle arrays
implementation: After coincident-patch visibility selection, count 722 triangles per visible fixed-grid patch. Reserve count*sizeof(Triangle) through the PDF shared budget before allocating the array with exact requested capacity. Keep the reservation until sampling completes and the triangle array drops. Coons and tensor-product patch paths use this admission.
verified: Managed peak includes the complete generated Triangle array for the authored single RGB tensor patch.
Exact observed peak budget succeeds with identical pixels.
One byte below peak returns a structured memory error before array materialization.
Success retains only output credit; failure and output drop release all managed credit.
limitations: Color components beyond four may spill into separate SmallVec heap storage; those allocations are not included yet.
Source-owned triangle meshes, sampled mesh maps and visibility inventory remain outside this admission.
Parser and other renderer allocations still prevent claiming a complete RSS or allocator cap.
